_about: Hausa pages: what letters.restore_hausa (server) and page_letters.restoreHausa (phone) make of a line, and which words they mark. Read by backend/tests/test_hausa_restore.py and app/test/hausa_restore_test.dart, so both sides pass the same cases. Brydl's review, 13 Nov 2026; capitals and plain-then-hooked pairs, 22 Nov 2026.

cases.why: a capital K mid-sentence: hooked k, marked
a title-cased name: two K words side by side keep their capital; the last Kasa doesn't
punctuation around the word is kept
a comma after the word is kept
the line's first word may start a sentence (kafa is marked too: ƙafa)
a Wikipedia heading: the word after == starts the line
a list bullet: the word after it starts the line
a dash at the start of a line
after a full stop
cases.line: Ya tafi. Kungiyar ta kafa makaranta.
cases.restored: Ya tafi. Kungiyar ta kafa makaranta.

cases.why: after a question mark
cases.line: Me ya faru? Kungiyar ta zo.
cases.restored: Me ya faru? Kungiyar ta zo.

cases.why: after ! and a closing quote
cases.line: Ya ce "Ka zo!" Kungiyar ta zo.
cases.restored: Ya ce "Ka zo!" Kungiyar ta zo.

cases.why: a name: ƙano is not in the word list
capitals: a heading or a shout, left alone (still marked)
a small k is never changed, only marked
đ is ɗ, marked
Đ is Ɗ, marked
đ mid-sentence, marked
a K word before a name stays small: ƙasar Najeriya
a K word before a name stays small: ƙungiyar Paralympic
a capitalised neighbour that isn't a K word doesn't keep the capital
cases.line: Ya kafa Kungiyoyin Wasanni na duniya.
cases.restored: Ya kafa ƙungiyoyin Wasanni na duniya.

cases.why: plain d before đ: left as read, marked
cases.line: Ana kiran ta hadđaka a nan.
cases.restored: Ana kiran ta hadđaka a nan.

cases.why: plain b before ɓ (habɓakar is in the word list): left as read, marked
cases.line: Ana kiran ta habɓakar a nan.
cases.restored: Ana kiran ta habɓakar a nan.

cases.why: plain D before Ɗ: left as read, marked
plain k before ƙ: left as read, marked
a held word doesn't stop its neighbours being restored
doubled đđ is ɗɗ, not a pair
doubled ƙƙ is left alone
